day_shape: 83 items dominated by a heavy Khamenei Unity Week message cycle, IDF strikes killing Nukhba commanders in Gaza, Israeli indictment of two teenagers for alleged Iran-linked spying, and a $3.6bn Greece-Israel air defence deal; nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: Khamenei Unity Week message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRGC-affiliated Defa Press published extensive excerpts of the Supreme Leader's Unity Week message, calling for Muslim unity against the US and Israel and warning against internal division. The message was released to coincide with the closing of the International Islamic Unity Conference and the Prophet's birthday.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas commanders in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killings of multiple Hamas Nukhba Force commanders and operatives in northern and central Gaza, including Abd al-Fattah Abu al-Eish, named as an October 7 infiltrator, and Hani Abd al-Hai Fakhri Mazloum. A separate strike near Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah targeted a Hamas commander the IDF said was planning attacks.

threads.label: Alleged Iran-linked espionage cases
threads.summary: Israeli prosecutors indicted two teenagers aged 14 and 16 from the Haifa area on charges of carrying out photography, graffiti and recruitment tasks for an Iran-linked handler in exchange for money. Separately, the Shin Bet confirmed an Iranian threat against Yair Netanyahu, and the IRGC claimed it dismantled a cell in Sistan and Baluchistan allegedly linked to Israel and the US.

threads.label: US sanctions pressure on Iran's economy
threads.summary: Iran International reported Washington's Operation Economic Outcast targeting Iranian revenue channels via Dubai, Istanbul and Baghdad, and covered the lapse of a 12-year sanctions authorisation affecting TOEFL, GRE and Duolingo access for Iranian students. Jerusalem Post cited Prof. Uzi Rabi saying sanctions are increasingly hurting Iran's hard-currency access.

threads.label: Regional military posture and deals
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Greece is set to sign a $3.6 billion defence deal with Israel in Tel Aviv on Monday for a multilayered air defence system citing threats from Turkey and Iran. Times of Israel reported US diplomats and family members are returning to Middle East embassies after wartime evacuations, while CENTCOM posted imagery of a Marine MV-22 Osprey refuelling in the region.

threads.label: Israeli operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: IRIB reported Israeli forces demolished a residential building in the town of Houla and shelled the western Zawtar river channel in southern Lebanon. Hezbollah Secretary-General Sheikh Naim Qassem said in a Unity Week address that Israel had failed in three wars due to popular steadfastness.

threads.label: Iran naval and IRGC messaging post-war
threads.summary: Iran's navy commander said the force would continue with greater strength after the deaths of personnel, calling enemy calculations mistaken. A parliamentary security committee chair claimed the US had expected to defeat Iran in three days but failed after 40 days of war.
